movies.title: Interstellar
movies.review: The visuals are breathtaking, the score is hauntingly beautiful, and the story resonates on an emotional and philosophical level.

movies.title: The Dark Knight
movies.review: Heath Ledger’s Joker steals the show, delivering one of the greatest villain performances of all time. The best CBM for a generation

movies.title: La La Land
movies.review: A dazzling musical that blends nostalgia with modern storytelling. The ending hits hard — bittersweet and beautiful.

movies.title: Inception
movies.review: A layered, mind-bending puzzle that rewards multiple rewatches. Nolan at his absolute best.

movies.title: Whiplash
movies.review: Intense, raw, and electrifying. The final scene leaves you breathless. A masterclass in tension.

movies.title: The Social Network
movies.review: Fincher’s cold, precise direction pairs brilliantly with Sorkin’s rapid-fire writing.

movies.title: Coco
movies.review: A heartfelt exploration of family and memory with stunning visuals and emotional depth.

movies.title: The Lion King
movies.review: The lack of emotion and facial expressions makes you not get so attached unlike the animated one
